title: Principal Consultant (Senior Manager) - Operational Resilience & Cyber
description:
Principal Consultant (Senior Manager) - Operational Resilience & Cyber Risk

Location: London (Hybrid) | Practice Area: Finance, Risk, Regulatory & Financial Crime | Type: Permanent

Build resilience where it matters most across cyber, technology, and third-party risk

The Role

Capco is seeking experienced Principal Consultants in Operational Resilience and Cyber Risk to join our growing Finance, Risk, Regulatory & Financial Crime (FRRF) capability. In this senior role, you'll lead complex client engagements across financial services and energy, advising on regulatory expectations such as PRA and DORA while driving the design and implementation of robust resilience frameworks. You'll play a key role in shaping client strategy, leading transformation programmes, and contributing to capability growth. You'll also leverage approved AI tools and AI-enabled ways of working to enhance analysis, accelerate insight generation, and improve delivery while applying responsible AI practices and appropriate human oversight.

What You'll Do

• Lead operational resilience assessments, scenario testing, and control implementation programmes, identifying opportunities to leverage AI-enabled workflows and automation to strengthen resilience outcomes.

• Advise clients on regulatory readiness across PRA, DORA, and other resilience frameworks, translating regulatory expectations into practical transformation strategies and sustainable operating models.

• Oversee cyber risk, third-party risk, and vendor resilience assessments, using AI-enabled analytics where appropriate to strengthen risk identification, prioritisation, and decision-making.

• Design and implement governance models, dashboards, Important Business Services (IBS), Impact Tolerance (ITOL), and reporting frameworks, ensuring robust governance, validation, and oversight where AI-assisted tools are utilised.

• Lead cyber and technology resilience transformation initiatives, including tooling, cloud security, and control enhancements, while contributing to business development, proposition development, and capability growth.

What We're Looking For

• Extensive experience delivering operational resilience, cyber risk, and third-party risk transformation within financial services, energy, or management consulting.

• Strong understanding of regulatory frameworks including PRA, DORA, and related operational resilience standards.

• Proven experience leading complex transformation programmes, including scenario testing, IBS/ITOL calibration, control remediation, and operating model transformation.

• Experience using approved AI tools, automation, or advanced analytics to enhance resilience, risk management, and programme delivery while maintaining appropriate governance and professional judgement.

• Excellent communication, leadership, and stakeholder management skills with the ability to influence senior stakeholders across business and technology functions.

Bonus Points For

• Experience leading enterprise-wide operational resilience or cyber transformation programmes.

• Background in cloud security, cyber tooling implementation, cyber security architecture, or AI-enabled cyber analytics.

• Experience with vendor risk management, third-party governance, supply chain resilience, and remediation strategies.

• Proven track record of mentoring, coaching, and developing high-performing consulting teams.

• Experience contributing to business development, proposition development, and strategic client growth.

Why Join Capco

• Deliver high-impact transformation programmes for Tier 1 financial institutions.

• Work in a collaborative, flat, and entrepreneurial consulting culture.

• Access continuous learning, industry certifications, and structured leadership development.

• Help shape the future of cyber and operational resilience through innovation, automation, and technology.

• Be part of a team delivering meaningful change across financial services and energy.

Our Health Engineering Solutions (HES) team works side by side with customers to articulate a vision for success, and then make it happen. We know success doesn't happen by accident. It takes the right team of people, working together on the right solutions for the customer. We are looking for a seasoned Full Stack Engineer who will be a key driver to make this happen.
Our team supports the vision to improve patient quality care and consumer decision-making by hospital providers across the country, by collecting, computing, and publicly reporting outcomes-based hospital quality measure data. The ideal candidate will have a strong understanding of software development principles and a proven track record in backend development. Experience with Agile software development methodologies is a must, as we value collaboration and flexibility in our approach to project management.

title: Account Executive - Mid-Market (German-speaking)
description:
Munich Hybrid with lots of flexibility.

C2 German Language is essential

Relocation to Munich provided

At Secfix, we’re at the forefront of automating security compliance in Europe. We help companies get and stay ISO 27001, GDPR, TISAX, and SOC 2 fast and easy and reduce hundreds of hours of manual work.

Secfix is run by a 100% remote team with hubs in Munich, Berlin and London. We’re a high-performing team looking for passionate, execution-focused, owners to help us automate security and compliance for modern companies and become the European compliance automation leader.

We’ve just raised our $12M Series A and are backed by top VCs, including Alstin Capital, Neosfer (Commerzbank), and Bayern Capital.

About the Role

We’re hiring a Mid-Market Account Executive to help us build and scale our upmarket motion in the DACH region.

This role sits between SMB and mid-market. You’ll focus on higher-value, more complex deals, while still being hands-on and closing SMB opportunities when needed. You’ll work directly with the Head of Sales, CEO and GTM leadership to shape how Secfix sells into larger customers.

This is a quota-carrying, high-impact role with real influence on how Secfix scales into larger and more regulated customers.

What You'll Do:

You will play a big role in one of the biggest levers we have for growing the company: generating demand and closing deals. We don’t (and can’t afford to) micro-manage. We have gathered many best practices and will give you full context on things that work. You can test things out, but at the end of the day, you have full ownership in how you deliver your results (with a strong support network from within and outside the company). You will:

- Own and drive net-new revenue across mid-market accounts in DACH, with flexibility to close SMB deals when needed

- Manage the full sales cycle from prospecting to close for mid-sized and growing companies

- Build and maintain pipeline through outbound and inbound opportunities

- Lead structured discovery and run consultative sales cycles with multiple stakeholders

- Engage senior decision-makers (CTO, CISO, CIO, Head of IT, COO)

- Translate complex compliance and security topics into clear business value

- Collaborate closely with product, legal, onboarding, and domain experts

- Maintain accurate pipeline and forecasts in HubSpot

- Help define pricing, packaging, qualification, and sales playbooks for mid-market

- Share market feedback to shape positioning, messaging, and roadmap

About You:

- 3+ years of closing experience in B2B SaaS, with a strong focus on mid-market or upmarket deals

- Competitive and hungry to win deals

- Proven track record of consistently hitting quota on complex, high-value opportunities

- Experience managing longer sales cycles and multi-stakeholder decision processes

- Strong prospecting skills and the drive to source your own pipeline

- Ability to communicate complex topics clearly in both German and English

- Comfortable selling to C-level buyers (CISO, CIO, CTO, COO)

- Familiarity with SaaS sales methodologies (e.g. MEDDICC) is a plus

- Familiarity with sales tools (HubSpot, Clay, Zapier, Sales Navigator) is a plus

- Experience in an early-stage startup environment is a plus

Nice-to- have:

- Experience selling into regulated industries (e.g. financial services, healthtech, legaltech)

- Experience working in an early-stage start-up (Seed - Series B)

- Academic or extracurricular track record of high achievement (top university, competitive sports, etc.)

- Strong existing network in the DACH SMB or mid-market tech ecosystem

- Exposure to compliance, information security, risk, or GRC topics

What we offer

- Hybrid-Flexible Work: 2-3 days in our new sales office in Munich and added flexibility where needed.

- Competitive Salary: Industry-competitive local salaries.We pay local rates that are at or above the market. We share this philosophy with GitLab.

- Equity: Generous equity package -

Bright Vision Technologies is a technology consulting and software development company delivering cloud, AI, data, and enterprise solutions across the United States.
This is a fantastic opportunity to join an established and well-respected organization offering tremendous career growth potential.

Job Title: Workday Interface Developer

Experience Required: 6+ years

Sponsorship: U.S. Citizens, Green Card Holders, EAD Holders, and H-1B transfer candidates are encouraged to apply. We are unable to sponsor new H-1B visa petitions for this position.

The successful candidate brings strong engineering discipline, a clear communication style, and a track record of shipping meaningful work that holds up well in production.

• Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field.

• Five or more years of Workday integration development experience.

• Deep expertise in EIB, Workday Studio, and Core Connectors.

• Strong XSLT skills and experience with Workday Studio orchestrations.

• Hands-on experience with Workday REST/SOAP APIs.

• Strong understanding of the Workday data model and tenant configuration.

Kelvin is a Series B, fast-moving technology company, and our legal team is looking for a part-time paralegal to support our internal legal operations. This isn't a caseload-driven role; it's ongoing legal support: keeping our contract templates and playbooks current, reviewing incoming NDAs and other legal documents, and helping keep our legal files and internal policies organized and up to date. Like everyone here, you may be expected to work cross-functionally rather than staying inside a narrowly defined legal lane. • Experience with large industrial customers is a plus.

This is a part-time contractor role with a fixed monthly rate rather than hourly billing. Compensation ranges from $2,500 to $4,000 per month, depending on experience and profile, and covers availability and delivery across the responsibilities outlined above. We're looking for a leader to take ownership of Business Intelligence across South Africa's number one property and automotive websites, Property24 and AutoTrader. Leading the BI team and delivering sharp commercial analysis is the heart of this role - the reporting and insight that keep the business running and that leadership, Sales, Finance, Marketing, Operations, and Product depend on every day.

Over time, and as these foundations mature, you'll grow our data science capability - predictive pricing, anomaly detection, and ML applied to real product problems. Our commercial portfolio includes treatments for hypercortisolism and oncology, and the company has discovered more than 1,000 proprietary selective cortisol modulators and glucocorticoid receptor antagonists. title: Manager, Product Design: Application Observability
description:
We are a global team of innovators and pioneers dedicated to shaping the future of observability. At New Relic, we build an intelligent platform that empowers companies to thrive in an AI-first world by giving them unparalleled insight into their complex systems. As we continue to expand our global footprint, we're looking for passionate people to join our mission. If you're ready to help the world's best companies optimize their digital applications, we invite you to explore a career with us!

Your opportunity

New Relic is hiring an on-site design manager for our Hyderabad team, leading design for Application Performance Monitoring (APM) and Log Management - two of the platform's most used products. APM gives engineering teams full-stack visibility across their applications: connecting traces, metrics, and infrastructure data so they can find what's breaking and understand why. Log Management is where engineers go to make sense of raw data at scale - ingesting, parsing, and querying log data across their entire stack, without the operational overhead of managing it separately. These are the products engineers open when something is on fire, which means the design work is high-stakes and high-visibility.

This is an on-site role in Hyderabad. Many of the engineers and product managers you'll partner with are there too, and being present - in standups, reviews, and the quick conversations before a decision gets made - is part of how you'll build the relationships that make design effective. You'll also work closely with design, product, and engineering partners in the US and Spain, so operating across time zones and communicating well in writing are part of the job, not an afterthought.

You'll manage a small team of designers, own the quality of design work across APM and Logs, and stay close enough to the craft to contribute directly when it matters. If you've led a small design team on complex technical products and want clear ownership of both the work and the people - this is that role.

What you'll do

• Manage and develop your designers - run consistent 1:1s including regular career development conversations, give direct and specific feedback, set clear expectations for each person, and invest in their growth. Build a team culture where people feel they belong and different perspectives are welcome. You'll represent your team in calibration conversations and advocate for their work and careers within the broader design org.

• Own design quality across APM and Logs - review work critically, raise problems before they reach partners, and make sure the team is solving the right problems at the right level of craft. You're accountable for what ships.

• Keep the user's perspective in the conversation - design managers at New Relic are the voice of the user in product and engineering discussions. You bring user needs and research insights into roadmap conversations, not just design reviews.

• Partner with PM and Engineering - work with your product and engineering counterparts as a peer. Hold the design perspective, push back when the direction needs it, and communicate design's value in terms of outcomes the business tracks: adoption, retention, time to value.

• Keep the team focused and on track - manage incoming work, maintain visibility into what's in flight, help the team balance competing priorities, and set clear expectations with PM and Engineering partners about what's possible and when.

• Help your team use AI well - stay curious about tools like Figma AI, Claude, and Gemini and how they can help your designers work better: faster exploration, smarter prototyping, better research synthesis. You don't need to be an expert, but you're not slowing down experimentation either.

• Contribute IC design work when the work calls for it - you're an experienced designer, and there are moments where the team needs your hands on a problem. Roll up your sleeves when it's the right call; delegate when it isn't.

• Hire well

title: Proposal Writer
description:
A New Paradigm For Space Operations.
Who We Are:
Space Kinetic is a dual use space technology startup building a completely new architecture for space operations - one that brings the advantages of proliferated drone technology (low-cost, operationally flexible, attainable, distributed) to space missions while reducing the ecosystem's reliance on consumable fuel. In a world where many companies are focused on incrementally improving the status quo, we are focused on creating something entirely different - an architecture underpinned by new first principles to meet the opportunities and challenges of the third space age head-on. Our goal is to move away from one-to-one space architectures - where each satellite in a constellation has one (or a small # of) primary payloads attached to the bus -- and unlock a ‘one-to-many’ system, where each satellite has a large number of payloads which can be deployed from their host spacecraft at high velocities without firing a thruster.
This is not a role for someone looking for a traditional 40-hour work week. Space Kinetic is building ambitious, first-of-its-kind technology, and that requires urgency, ownership, and a high level of commitment to changing the foundational assumptions for everything we do in space.
What You’ll Do:

You will lead the development of high‑quality proposals for government agencies, commercial customers, and strategic partners: translating complex technical concepts into compelling, clear, and compliant narratives. This role sits at the intersection of strategy, engineering, and business development, offering a unique opportunity to shape how our technology is understood and adopted by the market.

Every MDR is developed and evaluated against four behavioral pillars. They're not corporate values on a wall, they're the operating system of the team.

 

🔥 Ownership. The non-negotiable foundation. Extreme ownership of pipeline outcomes and no excuses when a lead goes cold because you didn't respond fast enough or log your work properly. Intellectual honesty: truth over ego. Going above and beyond for the team's collective success, not just your own number.

 

⭐️ Obsession. The refusal to plateau. This is a high-rejection motion, so you study objection patterns, perfect talk tracks, and learn from every no. You compound knowledge: every call makes the next one better because you document what works and share it.

 

⚡️ Effectiveness. Winning by design, not effort alone. Converting high volume into high quality through sharp qualification, deep discovery, and meetings that actually stick. Every touch is chosen for maximum conversion impact.

 

🤖 AI Native. Using AI to amplify your own output, and positioning ClickUp's AI credibly to prospects. The bar: you're leveraging AI across research, outreach, follow-up, and CRM hygiene, and you can articulate our agentic AI value propositi

title: Senior Software Engineer (RCL)
description:
FairMoney is a pioneering mobile banking institution specializing in extending credit to emerging markets. In alignment with its vision, FairMoney is actively constructing the foremost mobile banking platform and point-of-sale (POS) solution tailored for emerging markets. title: Field Marketing & Partnerships Manager
description:
Your Mission

Cosuno is a B2B marketplace connecting general contractors and subcontractors across the construction industry. As our Field Marketing & Partnerships Manager, you'll build Cosuno's presence in the industry beyond our digital channels - trade fairs, conferences, partnerships and our own event formats. This isn't primarily an event-logistics role: you'll decide where Cosuno should show up, build formats and partnerships that make that presence matter, and turn every event and relationship into visibility, pipeline and proof points. You'll be one of the first to join the marketing lead in a lean marketing team: you'll shape how it operates as it scales, not just execute inside a fixed setup.

Your Responsibilities

- You shape event strategy alongside the marketing lead - identify and evaluate trade fairs, conferences and industry events worth Cosuno's time, and help build the annual calendar and budget priorities.

- You run events end-to-end - booths, logistics, suppliers, deadlines and on-site execution - working closely with Sales to bring the right prospects and customers into the room.

- You build Cosuno-owned formats - customer dinners, roundtables, breakfasts, workshops and webinars that bring customers, prospects and partners together.

- You build partnerships and industry relationships - media, associations, event organisers and commercial partners - finding ways to contribute expertise, not just sponsor or attend.

- You turn customers, experts and events into visibility - success stories, speaking, podcast and video opportunities, and reusable content for Marketing and Sales.

- You make it commercially valuable - target-account outreach with Sales, structured follow-up, and tracking what events and partnerships actually generate in relationships and pipeline, so no lead falls through the cracks.

What You Bring

- You've owned events, field marketing, community or partnerships in a B2B environment and can show the commercial impact they created - not just attendance numbers.

- You've organised or owned trade fairs, conferences or field-marketing programmes end-to-end.

- You move comfortably between strategy and execution - contributing to decisions on which events are worth Cosuno's time, then sorting the last logistics detail yourself.

- You're a strong communicator and relationship-builder, confident approaching customers, executives, partners and suppliers - and you can prepare and coach speakers.

- You have a strong sense for what makes an event feel well executed, not just organised, and you'd rather build from scratch than follow a playbook.

- You think beyond attendance numbers - relationships, opportunities and pipeline - and work effectively across Marketing, Sales and Customer teams.

- Fluent German and strong English.

Your Benefits

- Room to shape and grow: One of the first marketing hires - real ownership of events and partnerships, with plenty of space to make an impact.

- A product worth talking about: AI that analyzes millions of price data points to help construction companies bid better - something the industry actually wants to hear about at every fair and roundtable.

- Competitive compensation: Salary above market average, permanent contract in a stable, well-funded company.

- Work-life balance: Berlin Kreuzberg office or hybrid, flexible hours.

- Top-notch equipment: A new MacBook Pro.

- A great team: Open, international, with regular off-sites and team events.

- Growth & feedback: Open feedback culture with regular 1:1s and development conversations.

About us

Cosuno - Revolutionizing construction through technology.

We are Cosuno - a fast-growing tech startup that is making the construction industry more efficient and transparent with our digital platform for tenders and procurement processes. Our goal: to solve the most complex challenges in the industry with innovation and simplicity.

Join us - Build the future of construction.

- Maintain, build, and enhance operational reports to support data driven decision making.

description:
Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.

The world sees it as the Snap Store and marketplaces, behind the scenes it is a unified system that understands key concepts in software distribution - architectures, releases, betas, release candidates, stable releases, branches and more. If you have a passion for clean APIs, believe that great engineers ship software calmly and regularly against an agile plan, and know that tests are the key to higher velocity and reliability, you'll fit right in.

You will collaborate closely with other Engineering Managers, product managers, and architects, producing an engineering roadmap with ambitious and achievable goals.

This is a great opportunity to really learn how to do engineering of a highly-scalable SaaS product (think about the load on our systems when one of our largest Ubuntu Desktop snaps is updated by the publisher, for instance). In addition, you will have the opportunity to learn from Canonical 's world-class security team as we work collectively to deliver this capability, safely, to our customers around the world.

title: Partnerships Associate
description:
Partnerships Associate
Join a collaborative and ambitious team helping to grow referral partnerships in a modern, fast-growing conveyancing business.
We’re looking for a motivated and relationship-driven person to join Juno as a Partnerships Associate. This is an opportunity to play a key role in building and nurturing relationships with estate agents and mortgage brokers, helping to drive new business and support our continued growth.
Juno is a law firm for the digital age. We’re on a mission to transform the experience of buying and selling a home. We make conveyancing simpler, clearer and faster.
We’re growing fast, and we’re looking for someone who enjoys speaking to people, building relationships and working towards clear targets in a supportive and high-performing team. Previous experience in conveyancing, estate agency, or mortgage brokering is highly desirable.
Juno makes conveyancing simpler, clearer and faster

• Juno is a modern law firm specialising in residential conveyancing and operating throughout England and Wales.

• We complete thousands of sale, purchase and remortgage transactions each year, and we’re trusted with panel membership by 80+ mortgage lenders.

• We’re rated as one of the best conveyancing firms in the UK by our clients (5/5 on Trustpilot) and estate agents and brokers frequently tell us how much they enjoy working with us.

• We’ve built our own software in-house. Clients can do all their conveyancing online, and always know what’s going on. And we’ve optimised the process to complete transactions 50% faster than the average law firm.

About the role

• You’ll be responsible for building and managing relationships with our referral partners, including estate agents and mortgage brokers.

• You’ll be making outbound calls to warm contacts who have previously worked with Juno, gathering feedback and introducing them to our referral process.

• You’ll convert suitable contacts into active referrers, building your own pipeline and helping generate a steady flow of new client sign-ups.

• You’ll clearly explain how Juno works, including setting expectations around the types of work we can and can’t take on.

• You’ll assess whether potential partners are a good fit for Juno and for a long-term working relationship.

• You’ll act as the relationship manager for your partners, maintaining regular contact through check-ins and being responsive to queries or escalations.

• You’ll monitor referral activity, including lead flow and conversion rates, and work towards weekly and monthly targets.

• This is an ideal role for someone who enjoys building relationships, is confident on the phone, and thrives in a target-driven environment.

Salary
Basic salary of £28,000, with on-target earnings of £50,000 in your first year. Commission is uncapped and grows as your partnerships build. Our established team earn £55,000 to £90,000.
Join us
We’re looking for people who enjoy building relationships and want to grow their career at a law firm that’s doing things differently.
If that sounds like you, apply through our Recruitee service with a compelling cover letter and recent CV/résumé.
